The fix is commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc` (PR #2731, "Default the queue location to the one selected in Service Queues"), tagged to ticket O3-5958. It changes the new queue entry form's default `queueLocation` to the location selected in the Service Queues store, falling back to the session location. The store is set from the dashboard's selection, and that selection is what carries the ancestor location. I did not verify the ancestor resolution itself.

The fix is in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.component.tsx`:
- Line 68 reads `selectedQueueLocationUuid` from `useServiceQueuesStore()`.
- Line 81 sets `queueLocation: selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`. This is the line that makes the field non-blank.

The commit also adds two tests in `queue-fields.test.tsx` (lines 224-238). One checks that the field prefills from the store, and the other checks the session-location fallback.

The commit message also mentions a change to service-queues that defaults `queueLocation` asynchronously. The diff I read contains only the `queue-fields` component and its test, so I did not find that part. The store's setter `updateSelectedQueueLocationUuid` (`store.ts`, lines 45-48) is what writes the selected location, but it was not changed in this commit.
